events.text:
No evidence found in Britannica for the planet Neptune.

I ran two searches (`"planet Neptune"` and `"Neptune"`, both `side: both`). Both came back `low_confidence` (top rerank logit around −5.9, margin under 0.1), and every Britannica hit was an unrelated fragment — "XVII.", "HYDROSTATICS. Plate CCXXXIX.", "Englos", and a passage about hell and comets. The only place "Neptune" appeared at all was a passing mention inside a Wikipedia article on Lightning ([W:61344:1353843790]), which is not about the planet.

This is consistent with the source period: the Encyclopaedia Britannica covered here is the 1771–1797 edition, and Neptune the planet was not discovered until 1846, so it would not have an entry on it. (That date reasoning is an inference, not a cited fact from the tool.)

If you want, I can check whether there's a Britannica entry on Neptune the Roman god instead, or look at a specific entry id you have in mind.
